api_description: Upload mods, publish versions, edit listings and read your stats from scripts or AI assistants, without opening the website. Create a key, then follow the guide.
api_start_description: Save your key in the SOTF_API_KEY environment variable and run this to check it works.
api_link_guide_hint: Step by step: upload, publish, stats
api_link_reference_hint: Every endpoint, try it in the browser
api_ai_description: Paste this into Claude, Codex or another coding assistant before asking it to work on your mod. It tells the assistant where to start and how to use your key safely.
api_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
api_overview_title: What you can do with the API
api_overview_text: Everything below works from a script or an AI assistant with one of your keys, without opening the website.
api_can_publish: Publish new versions of your mods
api_can_edit: Edit your mod pages: description, tags, images, links
api_can_stats: Read your stats: downloads, views and followers over time
api_can_social: Comment, review and follow (keys with Interact)
api_prompt_key_hint: This prompt reads the key from the SOTF_API_KEY variable. To get a prompt with the key inside, create a key: the option appears when it is shown.
api_copy_prompt_with_key: Copy AI prompt with this key
api_prompt_with_key_hint: The prompt includes this key: paste it only into an assistant you trust, and revoke the key if it leaks.
